title: Walking around a hanger problem
author: SuddenAmbassador2951
selftext: So I am building a space game (browser game) and I have outposts… I arrive at the outpost (2d game) but I can’t get a 3d area properly with proper skins, proper room… like I’m looking to have a pilot walking around, npc around doing work at stations in the outpost/hanger… and I’m doing this with absolutely no idea how to do any of this … hence gpt lol. Can any help me out with some ideas or point me in the right direction? [Starbounder itch.io](https://spacegamerdude.itch.io/starbounder-black-routes)

comments.author: Fuzzzy420
comments.body:
I don't get your question. It seems you have a working hangar and shopping area? 
And what do you mean by 3d area In a 2d Game?

replies.author: SuddenAmbassador2951
replies.body: Sorry, it’s 2d flying around spaceship, but when we get into a hanger, or outpost, that area is in 3d… at least that’s what I am working on. But I’m trying to find a way to get it all to look good. Good 3d models, skinned, good walking animations… or perhaps that’s the wrong style… I should keep it also 2d… I originally wanted to use like a pokemon game boy style of a space hanger but the ai just couldn’t nail it on the head. I’m in limbo
